records.title: "Log In" in the menu opens the login screen with its username, password and Login controls
records.acText: WHEN the shopper opens the burger menu on the catalog and taps "Log In", the login screen shall display the username field, the password field and the Login button.
steps: Open the login screen from the menu

records.title: an empty username is rejected with "Username is required"
records.acText: IF the shopper submits password 10203040 with the username empty, THEN the login screen shall display "Username is required".
steps: Open the login screen from the menu

records.title: an empty password is rejected with "Enter Password"
records.acText: IF the shopper submits bod@example.com with the password empty, THEN the login screen shall display "Enter Password".
steps: Open the login screen from the menu

records.title: alice@example.com is rejected as locked out @smoke
records.acText: IF the shopper submits alice@example.com with password 10203040, THEN the login screen shall display "Sorry this user has been locked out."
steps: Open the login screen from the menu

records.title: a wrong password does not open the catalog
records.acText: IF the shopper submits bod@example.com with the wrong password xxxxxxxx, THEN the app shall keep the shopper on the login screen instead of opening the catalog.
steps: Open the login screen from the menu

expectedFailure.reason: The app signs bod@example.com in with any non-empty password.

records.title: a username with no account does not open the catalog
records.acText: IF the shopper submits nadie@example.com, a username that belongs to no account, with password 10203040, THEN the app shall keep the shopper on the login screen instead of opening the catalog.
steps: Open the login screen from the menu

expectedFailure.reason: The app signs in any username that belongs to no account.

records.title: the lockout message wins over a wrong password for alice@example.com
records.acText: IF the shopper submits alice@example.com with the wrong password xxxxxxxx, THEN the login screen shall display "Sorry this user has been locked out."
steps: Open the login screen from the menu
